high_level_description: This image is a meme that humorously depicts the scenario of being at a party when someone brings out a tray of fancy cheeses. The text at the top reads, "When I'm at a party and someone brings out a tray of fancy cheeses." The image itself shows two identical women standing side by side against a blue sky with clouds. Both women are wearing yellow tops and gray leggings. The woman on the left has her hands on her hips, while the woman on the right has one hand on her hip and the other resting on her thigh.
